title: Completion commutes with sign negation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction on $n$ coordinates, and let $x$ be a sign vector of length $n$. Completing the restriction obtained by reversing every fixed sign in $\rho$, using the coordinatewise negation of $x$, gives the coordinatewise negation of the completion of $\rho$ using $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
